info.description: A parent quote CLEARED FOR PUBLICATION, shown in the voices carousel on /parents-feedback/. ⚠⚠ THIS IS NOT THE FEEDBACK INBOX. Parent Feedback holds what parents SENT through the form — private correspondence about a named child, which no page reads. A row only reaches this collection after a person has spoken to the parent and obtained consent. ⚠⚠ THERE IS NO FIELD FOR THE CHILD'S NAME, AND THAT IS THE SAFEGUARD. Not a rule someone has to remember — the column does not exist, so a child's name cannot reach the page even by mistake. A parent can consent for themselves; consenting to make their child's name searchable on a school's public site is a different question, and this collection does not ask it. ⚠ CONSENT IS RECORDED, NOT ASSUMED. `consentOn` and `consentNote` exist so that months later anyone can see when it was given and how. A row without them should not be published.

quote.description: The parent's own words. ⚠ VERBATIM — never edited for tone, length or grammar. Shorten by asking the parent, not by rewriting them.

parentName.description: As the parent agreed to be named.

relation.description: ⚠ THE RELATION, NEVER THE CHILD'S NAME — 'Parent', 'Guardian'. The class goes in its own field.

className.description: OPTIONAL, and only where the parent agreed to it — 'Class V'. Leave empty and the quote shows the relation alone.

consentOn.description: The date consent was obtained. Required: a quote whose consent cannot be dated should not be on the site.

consentNote.description: How it was obtained — 'by phone, 12 Sep 2026, spoke to Mrs X' — so it can be checked later. Internal; never rendered.
